Stark Logistics Careers

Site Reliability Engineer

Stark Logistics moves freight for nine thousand shippers. Our platform team keeps the booking and tracking systems available around the clock, and we are adding a Site Reliability Engineer.

Responsibilities

  • Define service level objectives with product teams and build the alerting behind them.
  • Reduce toil: every repeated manual task becomes a script, then a service.
  • Take part in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation with engineers in three time zones.

Requirements

  • Five years running Linux services at scale, with strong experience with AWS.
  • Good judgement about risk, and the patience to write things down.
